sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: A basic introduction can combine your name with where you live.

items.spanish: Én Meg vagyok. Én itt lakom.
items.english: I am Meg. I live here.

sections.content: Two short sentences glued together — Én Meg vagyok. Én itt lakom. — is genuinely how Hungarians introduce themselves: name first, location second, no connecting word needed. Resist the urge to merge them into one long sentence with ‘and’; short, separate statements are the natural rhythm here, not a beginner’s simplification.
